title: Pick the pixel Veil
question: Five pixel directions, same layout: sessions on the left, live line-by-line redaction in the middle, Approve, Decline and Fix at the end. Open a card full size to watch the animation.

options.label: Bitmap Bone
options.lineage: the Gridmind bitmap screen you sent
options.thesis: Bone paper, black bars and signal red: the reference, turned into a working redaction desk.
options.viewport: Sessions rail, the document redacting line by line with red flashes, chat on the right, a pixel knight on guard.
options.risk: Closest to the reference, so the least surprising of the five.

options.label: Pocket DMG
options.thesis: The whole app in four greens; a Veil ghost walks down the margin and eats each value.
options.viewport: Sessions rail, the document with the ghost walking line by line, chat as a drawer underneath.
options.risk: Four greens limit state colours; reads as a toy if overused.

options.label: Night Watch
options.thesis: Every personal value is a data thief; each redaction shoots one down, and the log shows what was blocked.
options.viewport: Status bar, sessions rail, a row of invaders over the document going dark one by one, a defence log with Keep and Undo per change.
options.risk: Strongest stage story; a dark shell needs a bright projector.

options.label: Riso Ward
options.lineage: risograph zines in blue and fluorescent pink
options.thesis: A printed zine look: halftone blue rail, pink flashes, a white-hat hacker cat on duty.
options.viewport: Halftone sessions rail, the document in the middle, a changes list with Accept and Undo over the chat.
options.risk: Pink reads playful; less serious for solicitors.

options.label: Cobalt Firewall
options.thesis: Every hidden value lays one orange brick; the firewall grows as the document is cleaned.
options.viewport: Cobalt sessions rail with a growing brick wall and a robot guard, the document in the middle, chat on the right.
options.risk: Cobalt and orange are loud; the shell must stay quiet around the document.
